purpose: Build trust with named, high-profile customer endorsements in a horizontally scrollable card list.

motion.detail: horizontal flex scroller, scroll-snap-type x mandatory, no autoplay/arrows/dots; card hover swaps portrait-tile bg through pink/green/yellow/blue by index, 300ms transition-colors
motion.reducedMotionFallback: same drag-scroll behavior (not motion-sensitive beyond the 300ms hover color transition, which is short and non-parallax)

portraits.licensing: 5 real named people's real headshots (Karri Saarinen/Linear, Olivia Moore/a16z, Guillermo Rauch/Vercel, Deedy Das/Menlo Ventures, Nat Friedman). Never fabricate a fake person's photo/name/quote attributed as a real endorsement; a generator producing a new page must use its own site's own real, permissioned testimonials or omit this section.

companyLogos.licensing: Real trademarked logos (Linear, Vercel, a16z, Menlo Ventures) — reuse exactly or omit, never invent a fake associated brand.
